cards.example_en: The caravan crossed the desert with food and water.
cards.example_zh: 商队带着食物和水穿过了沙漠。

cards.example_en: I paid in cash because the card machine failed.
cards.example_zh: 刷卡机坏了，所以我付了现金。

cards.example_en: The library catalogue lists books by the author's name.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆目录按作者的姓名列出图书。

cards.example_en: A sudden change in the weather cancelled the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 天气突然改变，野餐只好取消。

cards.example_en: Mum wrote a cheque to pay the school fees.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈开了一张支票来付学费。

cards.example_en: The art room walls change colour whenever a new show goes up.
cards.example_zh: 每次有新展览，美术教室的墙就会换颜色。

cards.example_en: Convert these minutes into hours on the timetable.
cards.example_zh: 在时间表上把这些分钟换算成小时。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：公司的
cards.example_en: She works in a corporate office.
cards.example_zh: 她在一家公司的办公室上班。

cards.example_en: The cost of new football boots was more than I had saved.
cards.example_zh: 新足球鞋的花费比我攒下的钱还多。

cards.example_en: Paying the phone bill on time improved Dad's credit at the bank.
cards.example_zh: 按时交电话费，改善了爸爸在银行的信用。

cards.example_en: The grocery delivery arrived just as we sat down to eat.
cards.example_zh: 我们刚坐下吃饭，订的食品就送到了。

cards.example_en: My uncle took the train across Europe and posted a card from each city.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔坐火车穿越欧洲，每到一座城市就寄一张明信片。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：日常的
cards.example_en: Everyday shoes are fine for the walk, so leave the heavy boots.
cards.example_zh: 这次走路穿日常的鞋就行，把沉重的靴子留下。

cards.example_en: We did not see the full extent of the leak until we moved the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 直到挪开冰箱，我们才看清漏水的全部范围。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：喂饱的
cards.example_en: The cat is fed every morning.
